warning_source: Jake Sullivan / U.S. National Security Advisor
recipient: Tzachi Hanegbi / Israeli National Security Advisor
warning_summary: Direct warning during active Gaza fighting to de-escalate tensions and prevent further loss of life.
evidence_state: Official contemporaneous White House readout directly documents Sullivan's call with Hanegbi and the de-escalation warning. Accepted High confidence as a general regional-escalation warning; distinct from Austin→Gallant on the same day.
gaps: Not an Oct. 7/Hamas-invasion forecast. Do not infer that the 13 May ceasefire resulted from this warning.

warning_summary: Reported warning roughly three days before Oct. 7 that a major escalation or event was imminent.
evidence_state: Michael McCaul said after a classified U.S. briefing that Egypt warned Israel, but explicitly did not identify the recipient level. Israel Hayom subsequently quoted a senior U.S. participant in that briefing saying McCaul had misspoken/exaggerated and that the Egyptian warning discussed was low-grade/basic rather than concrete.
gaps: Need Egyptian/Israeli primary record identifying recipient, timing and exact content. Do not use McCaul alone to establish a specific warning or Netanyahu receipt.

recipient: Israeli Foreign Ministry and National Security Council
warning_summary: Later reporting alleges Egyptian officials warned Gaza was explosive and that a focused warning that something big was coming reached the NSC.
evidence_state: Israel Hayom's Dec 2025 investigation cites senior Egyptian, Israeli Foreign Ministry and political sources, but the Foreign Ministry formally denied the described meeting/information and the NSC denied receiving a concrete Oct. 7 or war warning.
gaps: Need meeting records, named witnesses, diplomatic cable or authoritative inquiry evidence before acceptance. Keep separate from WARN-8 and WARN-76.

warning_summary: Pre-meeting UK material said Cleverly would raise concern about rising violence and need for de-escalation.
evidence_state: The official post-meeting FCDO readout records the ministers mutually agreeing on the importance of de-escalation and preserving the status quo; it does not document a distinct one-directional warning delivered by Cleverly.
gaps: Do not publish as a separate warning absent stronger event-level evidence. The 11 Sep Cleverly warning remains separately represented.
